name: limit_draft_on_the_neutral_face
why: The same face given both as neutral and as the face to draft. It is the mistake of someone who has not understood that they are two different roles -- and it is not harmless: the neutral face is the plane the angle is MEASURED from, so asking to tilt it relative to itself means nothing. It is refused before calling, and the difference is explained instead of saying «invalid argument».
_why_this_is_the_refusal_that_can_be_wri: The real defect of this operation -- swapping the two roles -- cannot be put in a case: the roles are assigned by the code with the selection marks, and from outside there is no way to swap them. What can be caught from outside is the confusion between the two, and this is it.
